meta.tagline: Free, hands-on AI learning in libraries, churches, and community centers across South Carolina.
meta.recurring: New Intro to AI classes are added every month.

eventTypes.name: Intro to AI Class
eventTypes.description: A plain-language, no-laptop-required introduction to AI for anyone curious. The front door to everything SCAiL does.

eventTypes.name: AI for Your Work Workshop
eventTypes.description: Hands-on session for working adults applying AI to real job tasks — resumes, emails, scheduling, customer follow-up.

eventTypes.name: Youth AI Lab
eventTypes.description: A project-based program for ages 14–22, ending in a live demo day where teams present what they built.

eventTypes.name: Community Demo Day
eventTypes.description: Graduates and youth teams present their projects to family, funders, and local leaders. The celebration at the end of every cohort.

flagship.tagline: A statewide gathering on AI, opportunity, and the future of work in the Palmetto State.
flagship.description: Our vision for an annual flagship conference bringing together educators, founders, funders, and community leaders from all 46 counties — SCAiL's answer to a MAICON-scale event, built for South Carolina.
